topic: Discussing refund and exchange policies and related vocabulary.

pairs.said: And when I prepare the present for my wife, the earring or some gold product, that product usually have a warranty.
pairs.natural: And when I buy presents for my wife, like earrings or other gold products, they usually come with a warranty.

pairs.said: The customer bought a vacuum cleaner, but two weeks later, the vacuum cleaner doesn't work anymore. So she wanted to need a refund.
pairs.natural: The customer bought a vacuum cleaner, but it stopped working after two weeks, so she wanted a refund.

vocab.meaning: 연장 보증 (기본 보증 기간 이후 추가로 제공되는 보증)
